passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: My hometown is Seoul, and it is a big city.
phrases.ko: 나의 고향은 서울이고, 서울은 큰 도시예요.
phrases.zh: 我的家乡是首尔，它是一座大城市。
phrases.py: wǒ de jiā xiāng shì shǒu ěr， tā shì yī zuò dà chéng shì。

phrases.en: There is a long river, and there are many bridges.
phrases.ko: 긴 강이 있고, 다리도 많이 있어요.
phrases.zh: 那里有一条长长的河，还有许多桥。
phrases.py: nà lǐ yǒu yī tiáo cháng cháng de hé， hái yǒu xǔ duō qiáo。

phrases.en: The parks are quiet in the morning.
phrases.py: zǎo shàng gōng yuán hěn ān jìng。

phrases.en: The streets are busy in the afternoon.
phrases.py: xià wǔ mǎ lù shàng hěn rè nào。

phrases.en: My neighbor says hello when I walk by.
phrases.zh: 我走过的时候，邻居会问好。
phrases.py: wǒ zǒu guò de shí hòu， lín jū huì wèn hǎo。

phrases.en: I love my hometown because my family is here.
phrases.ko: 가족이 여기 있어서 나는 고향을 사랑해요.
phrases.zh: 我爱我的家乡，因为家人在这里。
phrases.py: wǒ ài wǒ de jiā xiāng， yīn wèi jiā rén zài zhè lǐ。

phrases.en: I live in this city, and I know its parks.
phrases.ko: 나는 이 도시에 살고, 공원을 잘 알아요.
phrases.zh: 我住在这座城市，也认识这里的公园。
phrases.py: wǒ zhù zài zhè zuò chéng shì， yě rèn shí zhè lǐ de gōng yuán。

phrases.en: A bridge crosses the river near our home.
phrases.ko: 우리 집 근처에서 다리가 강을 건너요.
phrases.zh: 一座桥在我们家附近越过河。
phrases.py: yī zuò qiáo zài wǒ men jiā fù jìn yuè guò hé。

phrases.en: On Sunday the park is full of families.
phrases.zh: 星期天公园里满是一家人。
phrases.py: xīng qī tiān gōng yuán lǐ mǎn shì yī jiā rén。

phrases.en: A kind neighbor makes a big city feel small.
phrases.ko: 친절한 이웃이 있으면 큰 도시도 작게 느껴져요.
phrases.zh: 善良的邻居让大城市也觉得小。
phrases.py: shàn liáng de lín jū ràng dà chéng shì yě jué de xiǎo。

phrases.en: I love Seoul, and I am proud of my hometown.
phrases.ko: 나는 서울을 사랑하고, 나의 고향이 자랑스러워요.
phrases.zh: 我爱首尔，也为我的家乡骄傲。
phrases.py: wǒ ài shǒu ěr， yě wèi wǒ de jiā xiāng jiāo ào。

full_passage_spoken: My hometown is Seoul, and it is a big city. There is a long river, and there are many bridges. The parks are quiet in the morning. The streets are busy in the afternoon. My neighbor says hello when I walk by. I love my hometown because my family is here. I live in this city, and I know its parks. A bridge crosses the river near our home. On Sunday the park is full of families. A kind neighbor makes a big city feel small. I love Seoul, and I am proud of my hometown.
full_passage_zh: 我的家乡是首尔，它是一座大城市。那里有一条长长的河，还有许多桥。早上公园很安静。下午马路上很热闹。我走过的时候，邻居会问好。我爱我的家乡，因为家人在这里。我住在这座城市，也认识这里的公园。一座桥在我们家附近越过河。星期天公园里满是一家人。善良的邻居让大城市也觉得小。我爱首尔，也为我的家乡骄傲。
